map.批量生成 1024-65535 随机 TCP/UDP 端口，可自动避开常用保留端: Batch-generate random TCP/UDP ports from 1024–65535, optionally avoiding common reserved ports, with a quick-reference table of common ports.
map.生成未被占用的随机端口号。: Generate random port numbers that are not in use.
map.：端口号 0–65535，分公认端口（0–1023）、注册端口（1024–491: : Port numbers range 0–65535, divided into well-known ports (0–1023), registered ports (1024–49151), and dynamic ports (49152–65535).
map.：从动态端口段选取，可最大程度避免与已知服务冲突。: : Picking from the dynamic range avoids conflicts with known services as much as possible.
map.：0–1023 为特权端口，绑定需要管理员/root 权限。: : 0–1023 are privileged ports; binding them requires admin/root privileges.
map.：使用前应实际检测端口占用情况，避免启动失败。: : Before use, actually check port occupancy to avoid startup failures.
map.本地起多个测试服务时挑一个未被占用的动态端口，避免写死 8080 导致并行任务互: When running multiple local test services, pick an unused dynamic port to avoid hardcoding 8080 and having parallel tasks contend for it.
map.1024 以下需特权，动态端口段冲突少。: Below 1024 needs privileges; the dynamic range has fewer conflicts.
map.生成的端口一定没被占用吗？: Are the generated ports guaranteed to be free?
map.不一定。本工具只是按 IANA 规定从动态/私有端口范围（49152–65535: Not necessarily. This tool simply picks random values from the dynamic/private range (49152–65535) per IANA rules; it cannot know in real time which ports are occupied on your machine—browsers are also restricted from scanning local ports for security. Before use, confirm with netstat/lsof, or let the program bind port 0 and let the OS assign one.
map.生成个数取输入值并保证在 1 到 20 之间。循环直到凑够数量或尝试次数达到 1: The count is taken from the input and clamped to 1–20. It loops until enough ports are collected or 1000 attempts are reached: each attempt fills an unsigned 32-bit integer with cryptographically secure randomness, and the port = 1024 + random mod (65535 − 1024 + 1), i.e. in the range 1024–65535; when "avoid common reserved ports" is on and the port hits the reserved table it is skipped; duplicates of already generated ports are skipped. Finally it lists each port with its protocol and notes the count and whether common reserved ports were avoided
